maker: Hyundai Engineering Co., Ltd. with J2 E&C
name: Hyundai Engineering exterior wall painting robot
summary: Remote-controlled, wire-suspended spray unit that paints building facades in place of painters on a suspended platform, with attitude control, two stabilising fans and a dust-collecting spray hood. Developed by the Korean contractor Hyundai Engineering with the painting firm J2 E&C and designated Korean Construction New Technology No. 1042 in February 2026.

germany.statusNote: No sale, rental or licence offer found. Hyundai Engineering plans to use the robot on more facade types and high-rise buildings in Korea; no German or EU route exists.

specs.label: Speed compared with manual painting
specs.quote: 현장 실증 결과 기존 인력 작업 대비 약 2배 빠른 시공 속도를 구현했다

specs.label: Overspray reduction
specs.conditions: with the dedicated undiluted low-overspray paint, compared with water-based paint
specs.quote: 기존 수성 도료 대비 비산량을 90% 이상 줄이는 성과를 거뒀다

specs.label: Control
specs.value: unmanned, remote control from the ground or the roof
specs.quote: 작업자는 지상이나 옥상에서 장비를 원격으로 조작할 수 있어

specs.label: Spray method
specs.value: continuous up-and-down spraying with multiple nozzles
specs.quote: 상하 연속 스프레이 방식과 다중 노즐 분사를 적용해

specs.label: Stabilisation
specs.value: attitude control with horizontal sensors and two sub-fans against wind
specs.quote: 2개의 서브펜(sub-fan) 구조를 적용해 바람 등 외부 환경 변화에도 장비의 안정성을 유지하도록 했으며

specs.label: Overspray capture
specs.value: anti-scatter case, dust filter and double dust-collection fan, triple filter
specs.quote: 비산 방지 케이스와 집진필터, 이중 집진 팬을 기본 적용해

specs.label: Certification
specs.value: Korean Construction New Technology No. 1042 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport)

notes: Hangs from a dedicated roof support on high-durability wires and replaces the suspended painter's platform; altitude sensors stop it automatically.
Works outdoors on building facades; no drive of its own on floors.
Developed and field-tested since 2020; shown at an LH construction-automation robot demonstration in 2023 and given an innovation award at the 2024 Smart Construction Challenge.
